---
title: "My Projects"
listing:
  contents: 
    - "projects/python/*/index.qmd"
    - "projects/r/*/index.qmd"
    - "projects/external.yml"
  type: grid
  fields: [image, date, title, reading-time, categories, description]
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  sort: "date desc"
---

```{=html}
<script>
// Pages with the "Live data" category are re-executed nightly: give that chip a live style.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing .listing-category").forEach(function (chip) {
    if (chip.textContent.trim() === "Live data") {
      chip.classList.add("live-category");
      chip.textContent = "Live · updated nightly";
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
